涂出要重绘的区域；在右边勾选「只重绘蒙版区域」再发送，就是局部重绘: Paint the area to redraw; tick “Redraw mask only” on the right and send to inpaint
游戏 UI 和网页 UI 的控件不能混用: Game UI and web UI widgets can’t be mixed
点一下要改的位置，打一个点: Click where it needs to change to drop a pin
点下面的按钮，会打开浏览器的扩展页面，并打开文件夹选中 extension 文件: The button below opens the browser’s extensions page and a folder window with the extension folder selected.
点关键帧修改；拖动关键帧改时间（按住 Shift 对齐到 0.1 秒）；双击轨道: Click a key to edit it; drag keys to retime (hold Shift to snap to 0.1s); double-click an empty spot on a track to add a key
点右上角的导出，给 UE 或网页用: Use Export at the top right for UE or the web
点差异看是哪里不对：改元素重新跑，或者接受这处差异: Open a difference to see what is wrong: fix the elements and rerun, or accept it
点框看它的类型和名字；拖动改位置，拖右下角改大小，Delete 删掉。: Click a box to see its type and name. Drag to move, drag the bottom-right corner to resize, press Delete to remove.
照原画写上文字: Type the text from the concept
照着附上的截图做一个一样的界面（点左下角的 + 附上截图，或直接粘贴）: Recreate the screen in the attached screenshot (attach it with + at the bottom left, or just paste it)
照着附上的截图做一个一样的页面（点左下角的 + 附上截图，或直接粘贴）: Recreate the page in the attached screenshot (attach it with + at the bottom left, or just paste it)
版本列表没有取到：{error}: Could not load the version list: {error}
版本名，例如：第一稿、给老板看的: Version name, e.g. First draft, For review
生成还没生成和失败的图片: Generate images that are missing or failed
用对话设计游戏界面和网页：AI 改控件树、加图片和动画，出整屏原画、按原画抠切图: Design game UIs and web pages through chat: AI edits the widget tree and adds images and animations, then produces full-screen concept art, cuts slices from it and restores them, with annotations, versions and export (UE widget tree, React page, ZIP). Formerly the panel's built-in "Design" mode.
用对话设计游戏界面：AI 搭好 UMG 控件树、生成每一张图片，最后导出成 Wi: Design game UI by chat: AI builds the UMG widget tree and generates every image, then you export the WidgetTree JSON and textures and import them into UE as a Widget Blueprint.
用对话设计网页界面：AI 用自动布局搭好页面、生成插图和图标，最后导出成 HTM: Design web pages in chat: the AI builds the page with auto layout, generates illustrations and icons, and exports HTML / CSS with images you can open in a browser.
用浏览器里的 Gemini / ChatGPT 生成图片: Generate images with Gemini / ChatGPT in your browser
用笔刷涂出要重绘的区域，涂错了用橡皮擦或撤销: Paint the area to redraw; use the eraser or undo to fix mistakes
用设置里的图片模型生成: Generate with the image model from settings
用选中的浏览器标签页生成: Generate with the selected browser tab
画布太窄，先收起了 AI 对话；点左上角的对话按钮可以再打开: The canvas got too narrow, so the AI chat was collapsed. Use the chat button at the top left to open it again
画布是空的：这棵树里还没有可截的控件，先搭好界面再截图: The canvas is empty: this tree has no widgets to capture yet. Build the interface before taking a screenshot
画布没有画出来（页面可能正在切换），请重试: The canvas was not drawn (the page may be switching). Try again
登录后停在聊天页面，之后就能在对话框下面选这个标签页。: Sign in and stay on the chat page. Then pick that tab below the chat box.
直接搭界面（点一下改成先出原画；右键设置一次出几张）: Builds the UI directly (click to draw concepts first; right-click to set how many per round)
看一眼切图和干净背景；有不像的可以在图片里精修。确认后搭控件树: Look over the assets and the clean background; refine any that differ in Images. Confirm to build the widget tree
看切图和干净背景像不像原画: Check the assets and clean background against the concept
确认交付，进入画布继续改或导出: Confirm delivery, then keep editing on the canvas or export
确认后就可以像平常的设计一样导出 UE 或者继续让 AI 改: After confirming, export to UE or keep asking AI to change it like any design
确认用这张作为最终效果，AI 会照着它搭界面、出切图: Use this as the final look; the AI will build the UI and generate the assets from it
确认这就是要还原的 PSD，下一步按图层列出所有元素: Confirm this is the PSD to restore; next, every element is listed from its layers
确认这就是要还原的那张原画，下一步自动拆出所有元素: Confirm this is the concept to restore; next, all elements are detected
等 AI 回答完再分析: Answer the AI’s question before analyzing
等当前这一轮结束再修改: Wait for the current round to finish before applying this
等当前这一轮结束再分析: Wait for the current round to finish before analyzing
网格吸附：拖动和缩放落在 8 像素的网格上: Grid snapping: moves and resizes land on an 8 px grid
自动修正：{n} 个元素和子控件的模板位置差太多，挪出来单独摆: Auto-fix: {n} elements were too far from the sub-widget template and are placed on their own
自动修正：{n} 个容器按 flex 排会跑位，改成了绝对定位: Auto-fix: {n} containers drifted under flex layout and now use absolute positioning
自动修正：{n} 组格子大小、间距不齐，没抽成子控件: Auto-fix: {n} groups have uneven cell sizes or spacing and were not made into sub-widgets
蒙版涂抹：涂出要重绘的区域: Mask: paint the area to redraw
补充说明，或直接发送让 AI 按标注修改: Add details, or just send to let the AI follow the annotations
让 AI 列出要生成的切图: Ask the AI to list the slices to generate
让 AI 搭界面时会一起给出这个界面需要的数据结构；有了集合以后，列表控件按行渲: The AI provides the data structure for this screen when it builds the UI. Once a set exists, list widgets render by row, so you can see items, selected and locked states in the slots. You can also create a set manually.
让 AI 照着模板或描述搭界面: Ask the AI to build the UI from the template or your description
设计放在 UI 项目里（和 Agent 的项目分开）。先建一个项目吧，一般一个游: Designs live in UI projects (separate from Agent projects). Create one first, usually one per game.
设计里没有用到这张图: This image isn’t used in the design
设计里还没用到这张图: Not used in the design yet
说明要怎么改，例如：按钮换成金色描边: Say what to change, e.g. give the button a gold outline
说明这块要改成什么，例如：换成金色描边的按钮: Describe what this area should become, e.g. a button with a gold outline
调整区块：拖动移动，拖右下角改大小，点一下改名或删除；没问题就确认: Adjust the regions: drag to move, drag the bottom-right corner to resize, click to rename or delete; confirm when ready
超过 5 分钟没有完成，已停止: Stopped after not finishing within 5 minutes
运行模式 · 按 Esc 退出: Play mode · press Esc to exit
运行模式：像游戏里一样点按钮看效果: Play mode: click buttons like in the game
还原做完了：之后就像平常的设计一样，在画布里继续改、让 AI 改，或者导出到 U: Restore finished. From here it is a normal design: keep editing on the canvas, ask AI to change it, or export to UE.
还原完成（有没过门槛的差异已接受）: Restore finished (differences below the threshold were accepted)
还没有 UI 项目。UI 设计的项目和 Agent 的项目是分开的。: No UI projects yet. UI design projects are separate from Agent projects.
还没有切图：确认上一步后自动从原画里抠: No assets yet: they are cut from the concept after you confirm the previous step
还没有图片。在左边告诉 AI 想要什么界面，它会列出需要的图片并生成。: No images yet. Tell the AI on the left what UI you want and it will list and generate the images it needs.
还没有图片：在「图片」里上传或让 AI 生成。: No images yet: upload some under “Images” or let the AI generate them.
还没有控件绑定这个集合: No widget uses this set yet
还没有校验：搭建确认后自动逐个核对: Not verified yet: each element is checked after you confirm Build
还没有版本。AI 每次修改前会自动存一个，也可以在上面手动存。: No versions yet. One is saved automatically before every AI change, or save one above.
还没有英文，会直接用中文: No English yet; the original text is used
还没有设置。设置后项目里所有界面风格统一: Not set yet. Set them to keep every screen in the project consistent
这一轮收不下，结束后自动接着处理: This turn can't take it, so it runs right after
这个 UI 项目已经不在了。: This UI project no longer exists.

这个设计里已经有同名的子控件: This design already has a widget with this name
这个集合还没有字段：加上字段以后，行里的值才能绑定到控件。: This set has no fields yet: add fields so row values can bind to widgets.
这个项目还没有选择目录: No directory selected for this project yet
这个项目里每一张图生成时都会自动带上打开的提示词，设计界面的 AI 也会照着它来: Every image generated in this project automatically includes the enabled prompts, and the design AI follows them too, so the whole game's UI stays consistent. The image AI receives the English version of each prompt.
这个项目里还没有子控件。让 AI 把重复的部分（列表项、格子、按钮）做成子控件，: No widgets in this project yet. Ask the AI to turn repeated parts (list items, slots, buttons) into widgets and they show up here.
这个项目里还没有界面。: This project has no screens yet.
这个风格的提示词都已经有了: All prompts of this style are already here
这张从确认的原画里按位置抠出来，和原画一模一样。精修会照着它重画得更干净，和原画: Cut from the approved concept at its position, identical to the concept. Refine redraws it cleaner; results not similar enough (below the threshold in Settings) are not used.
这张图上还有没发出去的标注，确认模板后标注会被清掉: This image still has unsent marks; they'll be cleared once it becomes the template

连同它用到的图片一起加进这个设计: Add it to this design along with the images it uses
选一种标注工具，在图上标出要改的地方: Pick an annotation tool and mark what to change on the image
选上面的框选、箭头、画笔或打点，在图上标出要改的地方，再在右边的对话框里写修改意: Pick box, arrow, pen or pin above, mark what to change on the image, then write your notes in the chat on the right and send
选中一个控件查看和修改它的属性: Select a widget to view and edit its properties
选中一张图片查看它的每一版和生成设置: Select an image to see its versions and generation settings
选中控件后加轨道: Select a widget to add a track

选中控件，用左边的「加轨道」或上面的「预设」开始: Select a widget, then use “Add track” on the left or “Presets” above
选择原画（PNG、JPG、WebP 或 PSD）: Choose a concept (PNG, JPG, WebP or PSD)
逐个核对和原画差多少: Check each element against the concept
